references.text: The account of the conquest of Jericho, where the king of Jericho was defeated by Israel under Joshua's leadership.
The first attack on Ai, the city located next to Bethel, which failed because of Achan's sin.
The conquest of Ai and the defeat of the king of Ai, who was hanged on a tree.
Bethel is mentioned as a place in the land of Canaan, near where Abram camped.
Jacob named the place Bethel, which means 'House of God', the same Bethel mentioned in connection with Ai.
Jericho is mentioned as the place where Israel camped before crossing the Jordan into the Promised Land.
Jericho is described as the city of palms in the description of the borders of the Promised Land.
